tables.constraints:

ALTER COLUMN created_at SET NOT NULL

tables.name: products

ADD CONSTRAINT pk_products PRIMARY KEY (id)

ALTER COLUMN created_at SET NOT NULL
ALTER COLUMN updated_at SET NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_products_promotion_id ON products (promotion_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_products_brand_id ON products (brand_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_products_default_variant_id ON products (default_variant_id)

tables.name: orders
tables.constraints:
ADD CONSTRAINT pk_orders PRIMARY KEY (id)
ADD CONSTRAINT uk_orders_order_code UNIQUE (order_code)

    FOREIGN KEY (voucher_id) REFERENCES vouchers (id)
ADD CONSTRAINT fk_orders_user_address
    FOREIGN KEY (user_address_id) REFERENCES user_addresses (id)
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_orders_order_code CHECK (btrim(order_code) <> '')
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_orders_total_amount CHECK (total_amount >= 0)
ADD CONSTRAINT ck_orders_sub_total CHECK (sub_total >= 0)

ALTER COLUMN order_code SET NOT NULL
ALTER COLUMN user_id SET NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_user_id ON orders (user_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_voucher_id ON orders (voucher_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_user_address_id ON orders (user_address_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_orders_checkout_key ON orders (user_id, idempotency_key) WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL
